title: Vanguard’s New Custom Model Portfolios Hope to Prove One Size Doesn’t Fit All
excerpt: Vanguard will now let advisors tailor certain models to their specific values and tax preferences.
content_html:
Concerned about an AI bubble? Sign up for The Daily Upside for smart and actionable market news, built for investors.

There are models everywhere, and we're not talking about fashion week.

Vanguard on Wednesday announced new customizable model portfolios, which will allow advisors to tweak the firm's existing strategies and customize them based on client preferences. Advisors can work with one of three selected partners — Vestmark, Orion or SS&C Black Diamond Wealth — to adapt the models to fit values and tax preferences. The move highlights the $13 trillion asset manager's efforts to keep up with custom momentum: Last year, Goldman Sachs launched its own public-private portfolios, and custom model portfolio assets hit $258 billion in March, a 40% increase year over year, according to recent Morningstar data. The Vanguard offering is the latest option for advisors building custom portfolios for their clients.

"This is just a natural proliferation of everybody's preference to have more tailored experiences," said Rob Battista, executive vice president at Vestmark. "Whether people are buying cars or clothes these days, they expect a very tailored experience. And investors and advisors don't feel any differently about their investments."

Customized Craze

Initially, Vanguard plans to roll out four model families, according to the firm. Those options include active-passive, dynamic active-passive, fixed-income and income-oriented products.

"The framework for this is, 'Mr. and Mrs. Advisor, you commit assets to me, we'll create 10, 20 custom models that no one else sees,'" Battista said, adding that Vanguard helps advisors understand what their needs and preferences are. "Then I have 10 or 20 models that are specific to my practice."

The target audience is mostly the independent channel, since larger broker-dealers already allow for more customization. The partner firms will act as subadvisors, although the advisor is still the one making the investment decisions, Battista said.

Model Citizens. While it's still early innings for the trend, there have been major improvements in investment technology that allow for better customization, Battista added.

"What you're seeing now are asset managers coming in to address some of the pushback on traditional models," he said, adding that they were more rigid and didn't consider taxes. "Now asset managers' solution to that is … 'We'll build it together.'"

到处都是模特，我们不是在谈论时装周。

先锋集团周三宣布了新的可定制模型投资组合，这将允许顾问调整公司现有的策略，并根据客户的偏好进行定制。 顾问可以与三个选定的合作伙伴之一（Vestmark、Orion 或 SS&C Black Diamond Wealth）合作，调整模型以适应价值和税收优惠。 此举突显了这家 13 万亿美元资产管理公司为跟上定制势头所做的努力：去年，高盛推出了自己的公私投资组合，根据晨星公司最近的数据，3 月份定制模型投资组合资产达到 2,580 亿美元，同比增长 40%。 Vanguard 产品是顾问为其客户构建定制投资组合的最新选择。

Vestmark 执行副总裁罗布·巴蒂斯塔 (Rob Battista) 表示：“这只是每个人都希望获得更量身定制的体验的自然扩散。” “如今，无论人们购买汽车还是衣服，他们都期望获得非常量身定制的体验。 投资者和顾问对他们的投资没有任何不同的感觉。”

定制热潮

据该公司称，Vanguard 最初计划推出四个型号系列。 这些选择包括主动-被动、动态主动-被动、固定收益和收入导向型产品。

“这个框架是，‘顾问先生和夫人，你们将资产交给我，我们将创建 10、20 个其他人看不到的定制模型，’”Battista 说，并补充说 Vanguard 帮助顾问了解他们的需求和偏好。 “然后我有 10 或 20 个专门针对我的实践的模型。”

目标受众主要是独立渠道，因为较大的经纪交易商已经允许更多定制。 巴蒂斯塔表示，尽管顾问仍然是做出投资决策的人，但合作伙伴公司将充当次级顾问。

模范公民。 巴蒂斯塔补充说，虽然这一趋势仍处于早期阶段，但投资技术已经有了重大改进，可以更好地定制。

他说：“你现在看到的是，资产管理公司正在介入解决传统模式面临的一些阻力。”他补充说，他们的做法更加严格，没有考虑税收。 “现在资产管理公司的解决方案是...... “我们将共同建造它。””
